nature_language: 当前位置杭州。我和朋友计划去广州玩三天，选择火车出行，市内交通方式选择打车。请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Hangzhou. My friend and I are planning to visit Guangzhou for three days. We have chosen to travel by train and use taxis for intra-city transportation. Please provide me with a travel itinerary.
